method: Descriptive sampling diagnostics on original v0.15 candidate versus v0.14.4. Bootstrap 100000 repetitions, deterministic PCG seed 151/20261115. Pair bootstrap resamples 25 color pairs. Opening-cluster bootstrap resamples 10 observed opening clusters with their full repeated observations. Conditional on this small fixed book; neither accounts for new-opening selection or multiple-hypothesis selection. Not SPRT or a certified strength confidence bound.
power_model: Illustrative independent-game normal approximation: two-sided alpha .05, power .8, fixed observed draw rate .26; n=(z.975+z.8)^2*(1-drawrate)/4/(logistic(Elo)-.5)^2. Does not model color-pair covariance, repeated books, multiple testing or workload shifts; not guaranteed sample requirements.
